what: 1. Build a multiband image from single-band TIFs
title: Getting started with saltbush
text: example data ships five single-band TIFs drone flight Fowlers Gap, NSW (blue, green, red, red_edge, nir).
code: input_dir <- system.file("extdata/create_multiband_image",                          package = "saltbush")  multiband <- create_multiband_image(   input_dir,   desired_band_order = c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir"),   output_dir = tempdir(),   return_raster = TRUE )

title: Getting started with saltbush
text: pair multiband image area--interest (AOI) file. package ships small aggregated raster matching AOI demonstration: AOI files can shapefiles, GeoJSON GeoPackage. AOI’s coordinate system differs imagery’s, reprojected match.
code: raster_files <- list.files(   system.file("extdata/example", package = "saltbush"),   pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE )  aoi_files <- list.files(   system.file("extdata/aoi", package = "saltbush"),   pattern = "NSABHC0009_aoi\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE )

title: Getting started with saltbush
text: calculate_spectral_metrics() works directly rasters, cropping masking AOI, returns three metrics per AOI: CV — coefficient variation SV — spectral variance CHV — convex hull volume
code: metrics <- calculate_spectral_metrics(   raster_files, aoi_files,   wavelengths = c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir"),   masked = FALSE,   rarefaction = FALSE ) metrics #>         site aoi_id       CV          SV          CHV image_type #> 1 NSABHC0009      1 0.334488 0.001761305 3.347609e-10   unmasked

title: Getting started with saltbush
text: --ground side, package ships cached AusPlots point-intercept dataset site (NSABHC0009) worked example need network access: returned metrics species richness, Shannon’s diversity, Simpson’s diversity, Pielou’s evenness, exponential Shannon’s, inverse Simpson’s. pull fresh query AusPlots database (query plots), use ausplotsR::get_ausplots():
code: field_diversity <- calculate_field_diversity(ausplots_NSABHC0009) field_diversity$taxonomic_diversity #>        site_unique site_location_name species_richness shannon_diversity #> 1 NSABHC0009-58026         NSABHC0009               52          3.056908 #> 2 NSABHC0009-53604         NSABHC0009               38          2.843074 #>   simpson_diversity pielou_evenness exp_shannon inv_simpson #> 1         0.9203249       0.7736571    21.26171    12.55097 #> 2         0.9043699       0.7815826    17.16846    10.45696 my.data <- ausplotsR::get_ausplots(   my.Plot_IDs = c("NSABHC0009"), veg.PI = TRUE ) calculate_field_diversity(my.data$veg.PI)

title: Getting started with saltbush
text: High-resolution drone images large; example data shipped package intentionally small (just enough run examples tests). compare spectral taxonomic diversity meaningfully, run steps full-resolution imagery sites. complete, real-world analysis built saltbush — including full-resolution imagery workflow — see companion repository adelegem/multispectral_drone_svh.

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: saltbush processes drone imagery calculate spectral diversity values part assessment ‘spectral variability hypothesis’ ‘spectral-biodiversity relationship’. specifically implemented connect --sky diversity --ground diversity measured AusPlots project. functions calculate --ground diversity built ausplotsR vegan packages. package aimed making --sky diversity methods development easier researchers across world. Specifically used package test Australian arid zone. results suggest methods perform much better others. code reproduces full analysis available adelegem/multispectral_drone_svh.

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
code: install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("traitecoevo/saltbush", build_vignettes = TRUE)

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: sky: drone imagery spectral diversity create_multiband_image(): stack single-band reflectance TIFs one multiband image find_optimum_thresholds(): (optional) choose NDVI/NIR thresholds ground-truth points create_masked_raster(): mask bare ground shadow calculate_spectral_metrics(): CV, SV CHV area interest (AOI) ground: survey data taxonomic diversity calculate_field_diversity(): species richness, Shannon, Simpson Together: join two site AOI test spectral-biodiversity relationship. example runs every step data bundled package, AusPlots site NSABHC0009 Fowlers Gap, NSW. detail step, see vignette("saltbush").

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: users using Pix4D mapper pre-process imagery, single-band TIFs saved folder per site. can optionally use function create multiband image - file name must band name end , Pix4D output NSABHC0009_transparent_reflectance_blue.tif works without renaming. Output files named folder. five bands resulting image:  true-colour composite:
code: wavelengths <- c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir")  band_dir <- system.file("extdata/create_multiband_image", package = "saltbush") list.files(band_dir) #> [1] "blue.tif"     "green.tif"    "nir.tif"      "red.tif"      "red_edge.tif"  multiband <- create_multiband_image(band_dir,                                      desired_band_order = wavelengths,                                     output_dir = tempdir(),                                     make_plot = FALSE)

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: ground-truth points labelled class (e.g. vegetation vs bare ground), find_optimum_thresholds() finds NDVI NIR value best separates , per site: Otherwise, pass single threshold values next step, .
code: ndvi_thresholds <- find_optimum_thresholds(ground_truth,                                            site_col = "site",                                            band_or_index_col = "ndvi",                                            class_col = "class",                                            class_value = c("bare_ground", "rocks"))

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: image small clip, use bundled image whole NSABHC0009 plot (aggregated 1.5 m pixels keep package small). Pixels NDVI ndvi_threshold (bare ground) NIR nir_threshold (shadow) set NA:
code: plot_image <- system.file("extdata/example/NSABHC0009_aggregated.tif",                           package = "saltbush")  create_masked_raster(plot_image,                      output_dir = tempdir(),                      ndvi_threshold = 0.02,                      nir_threshold = 0.04)  masked_image <- file.path(tempdir(), "NSABHC0009_aggregated_masked.tif")

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: calculate_spectral_metrics() crops masks image AOI polygons calculates metrics directly raster. Rasters AOI files matched site name, start file name first _ . (NSABHC0009). AOIs can shapefiles, GeoJSON GeoPackage, reprojected image’s coordinate system needed.
code: aoi_file <- system.file("extdata/aoi/NSABHC0009_aoi.shp", package = "saltbush")  spectral <- calculate_spectral_metrics(masked_image, aoi_file, wavelengths) spectral #>         site aoi_id        CV           SV          CHV image_type #> 1 NSABHC0009      1 0.2502227 0.0008364104 1.544037e-10     masked

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: AusPlots point-intercept data (e.g. ausplotsR::get_ausplots()), defaults work , row one point-observation, dead material excluded: surveys, name species column, categories exclude, abundance column percent cover counts. , using bundled example cover data:
code: field <- calculate_field_diversity(ausplots_NSABHC0009) field$taxonomic_diversity #>        site_unique site_location_name species_richness shannon_diversity #> 1 NSABHC0009-58026         NSABHC0009               52          3.056908 #> 2 NSABHC0009-53604         NSABHC0009               38          2.843074 #>   simpson_diversity pielou_evenness exp_shannon inv_simpson #> 1         0.9203249       0.7736571    21.26171    12.55097 #> 2         0.9043699       0.7815826    17.16846    10.45696 head(cover_survey) #>   plot_id                species cover_pct #> 1  plot_A     Atriplex vesicaria        18 #> 2  plot_A    Maireana pyramidata        15 #> 3  plot_A Sclerolaena divaricata        12 #> 4  plot_A   Enneapogon avenaceus        10 #> 5  plot_A            Bare ground        35 #> 6  plot_A                 Litter        10  cover <- calculate_field_diversity(cover_survey,                                    aoi_cols = "plot_id",                                    species_col = "species",                                    exclude = c("Bare ground", "Litter"),                                    abundance_col = "cover_pct") cover$taxonomic_diversity #>   plot_id species_richness shannon_diversity simpson_diversity pielou_evenness #> 1  plot_A                4         1.3620209         0.7378512       0.9824904 #> 2  plot_B                3         0.5608217         0.2907986       0.5104820 #> 3  plot_C                2         0.5004024         0.3200000       0.7219281 #>   exp_shannon inv_simpson #> 1    3.904075    3.814628 #> 2    1.752112    1.410037 #> 3    1.649385    1.470588

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: Join spectral field diversity site (AOI, field plots match AOIs): One site shows mechanics. Testing relationship needs many sites, bundled images small . complete real-world analysis built saltbush, see adelegem/multispectral_drone_svh.
code: merge(spectral, field$taxonomic_diversity,       by.x = "site", by.y = "site_location_name") #>         site aoi_id        CV           SV          CHV image_type #> 1 NSABHC0009      1 0.2502227 0.0008364104 1.544037e-10     masked #> 2 NSABHC0009      1 0.2502227 0.0008364104 1.544037e-10     masked #>        site_unique species_richness shannon_diversity simpson_diversity #> 1 NSABHC0009-58026               52          3.056908         0.9203249 #> 2 NSABHC0009-53604               38          2.843074         0.9043699 #>   pielou_evenness exp_shannon inv_simpson #> 1       0.7736571    21.26171    12.55097 #> 2       0.7815826    17.16846    10.45696

title: Spectral Diversity from Drone Images
text: Spectral diversity (drone imagery): coefficient variation (CV) spectral variance (SV) convex hull volume (CHV) Taxonomic diversity (survey data): species richness Shannon’s diversity index Simpson’s diversity index Pielou’s evenness exponential Shannon’s index inverse Simpson’s index

what: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
text: cached subset point-intercept (veg.PI) table AusPlots site NSABHC0009 Fowlers Gap, NSW. Saved package dataset worked example tests require live access AusPlots database.

title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
code: data(ausplots_NSABHC0009)

title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
text: data frame one row per point-intercept hit: site_unique Character. Unique site/visit identifier. site_location_name Character. Site identifier. site_location_visit_id Integer. AusPlots visit identifier. transect Character. Transect identifier within visit. point_number Integer. Point number along transect. standardised_name Character. Standardised species name.

title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
text: Cached ausplotsR::get_ausplots() .Plot_IDs = "NSABHC0009". See data-raw/ausplots_NSABHC0009.R.

title: Cached AusPlots point-intercept data for site NSABHC0009 — ausplots_NSABHC0009
text: columns used saltbush plus useful identifiers retained — taxonomy columns free-text fields dropped keep file small.

title: Calculate field diversity — calculate_field_diversity
text: Takes species survey data calculates field diversity grouping specified aoi_cols. defaults suit AusPlots point-intercept data ausplotsR: grouping site_unique (one row per survey visit), species standardised_name, dead material excluded, row counted one hit. survey data can used changing species_col, exclude abundance_col.

title: Calculate field diversity — calculate_field_diversity
code: calculate_field_diversity(   survey_data,   aoi_cols = "site_unique",   species_col = "standardised_name",   exclude = c("Dead grass", "Dead shrub"),   abundance_col = NULL,   group_by_cols = NULL )

title: Calculate field diversity — calculate_field_diversity
text: survey_data data frame survey records, e.g. AusPlots point-intercept data ausplotsR, one row per record. aoi_cols character vector column names survey_data identify area interest (AOI), .e. unit diversity calculated . Defaults "site_unique", gives one row per survey visit. Pass e.g. c("site_unique", "subplot_id") compute diversity per subplot within site, match subplot AOIs calculate_spectral_metrics(). (Previously group_by_cols.) species_col name column holding species names. Defaults "standardised_name" (ausplotsR). exclude values species_col leave , dead material. Defaults c("Dead grass", "Dead shrub"); use NULL keep everything. abundance_col optional name numeric column holding abundance record (e.g. counts percent cover). NULL (default), row counts one hit, point-intercept data. Records zero abundance treated absent; negative missing values error. group_by_cols deprecated; use aoi_cols.

title: Calculate field diversity — calculate_field_diversity
text: list, containing 'taxonomic_diversity' - values species richness, shannon's index, simpsons index, exponential shannon's, inverse simpson, pielou's evenness, one row per unique combination aoi_cols, 'community_matrices' - list per-group community matrices keyed grouping values; matrix aoi_cols leading id columns followed one column per species.

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_spectral_metrics
text: Calculates CV, SV, CHV area interest (AOI) directly multiband rasters, without first extracting every pixel data frame. raster cropped masked AOI polygon; CV SV calculated per-band summary statistics (terra::global()), CHV matrix pixel values within AOI. Spectral variance (SV) standardized number spectral points, rarefied; rarefaction applies CV CHV .

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_spectral_metrics
code: calculate_spectral_metrics(   raster_files,   aoi_files,   wavelengths,   aoi_id_col = NULL,   masked = TRUE,   rarefaction = FALSE,   min_points = NULL,   n = NULL,   seed = NULL )

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_spectral_metrics
text: raster_files Character vector multiband raster file paths. site name taken start file name, first _ . (whole name, minus extension, neither), NSABHC0009_ortho.tif, NSABHC0009.ortho.tif NSABHC0009.tif give site NSABHC0009. aoi_files Character vector AOI file paths: shapefiles (.shp), GeoJSON (.geojson/.json) GeoPackage (.gpkg), containing one AOI polygons. raster matched AOI file site name, found way (e.g. NSABHC0009_aoi.shp). Files extensions (e.g. shapefile's .dbf) ignored. AOI's coordinate system differs raster's, AOI reprojected match. wavelengths Character vector naming wavelength raster layer, layer order. aoi_id_col Optional character; name column AOI file use aoi_id. NULL (default), AOIs numbered 1:n. masked Logical; labels output image_type "masked" "unmasked". mask image. rarefaction Logical; TRUE, CV CHV averaged n random subsamples min_points pixels per AOI, standardizes uneven pixel numbers across AOIs increases processing time. min_points Integer; pixels sampled per AOI rarefaction = TRUE. n Integer; number subsamples rarefaction = TRUE. seed Integer NULL; provided, set.seed(seed) called start rarefaction sampling reproducible.

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_spectral_metrics
text: data frame one row per AOI per raster, columns site, aoi_id, CV, SV, CHV image_type.

title: Calculate spectral metrics — calculate_spectral_metrics
code: aoi_files <- list.files(   system.file("extdata/aoi", package = "saltbush"),   pattern = "image_aoi\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE ) raster_files <- list.files(   system.file("extdata/multiband_image", package = "saltbush"),   pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE ) metrics <- calculate_spectral_metrics(   raster_files, aoi_files,   wavelengths = c("blue", "green", "red", "red_edge", "nir"),   masked = FALSE ) metrics #>        site aoi_id        CV          SV          CHV image_type #> 1 multiband      1 0.3355707 0.004328054 3.053635e-09   unmasked #> 2 multiband      2 0.3642174 0.003440723 3.238245e-09   unmasked #> 3 multiband      3 0.4671316 0.003904554 3.234787e-09   unmasked #> 4 multiband      4 0.3758902 0.001296762 1.625732e-09   unmasked

title: saltbush 0.2.0
text: calculate_spectral_metrics() now calculates CV, SV CHV directly rasters AOI files, replacing extract_pixel_values(), removed. Results match previous pipeline (see tests/testthat/test-reference_metrics.R). AOI files can GeoJSON GeoPackage well shapefiles. AOIs different coordinate system imagery reprojected, message. AOI files can hold several polygons (one row metrics ). AOI outside image, pixels convex hull, now gives NA metrics warning instead stopping run; duplicate aoi_id_col values warn. Rarefaction now checks min_points AOI rather whole site, uses subsample CV CHV draw, sets seed per call sites get independent draws. find_optimum_thresholds() now handles several class_values correctly. create_multiband_image() checks bands share extent, resolution CRS stacking, lists differ. create_multiband_image() matches band files whose names end band name, Pix4D output (e.g. NSABHC0009_transparent_reflectance_blue.tif) works without renaming. TIFs folder ignored. data-frame helpers calculate_cv(), calculate_sv() calculate_chv_nopca() removed; use calculate_spectral_metrics(). calculate_field_diversity(): group_by_cols renamed aoi_cols; old name still works deprecation warning. calculate_field_diversity() gains species_col, exclude abundance_col, works survey data beyond AusPlots point-intercepts (e.g. cover count data). Defaults reproduce previous results exactly. data.table stringr longer dependencies.

title: saltbush 0.1.0
text: Initial release. --sky spectral diversity: build multiband images single-band drone TIFs (create_multiband_image()), mask non-vegetation pixels NDVI/NIR thresholds (create_masked_raster(), find_optimum_thresholds()), extract per-AOI pixel values (extract_pixel_values()), compute spectral metrics — coefficient variation, spectral variance, convex hull volume (calculate_spectral_metrics() underlying calculate_cv(), calculate_sv(), calculate_chv_nopca()). --ground taxonomic diversity AusPlots point-intercept surveys (calculate_field_diversity()): species richness, Shannon, Simpson, Pielou’s evenness, exponential Shannon, inverse Simpson. Bundled example data (synthetic_survey, ausplots_NSABHC0009, example drone rasters) examples, tests, vignette run offline.
